title: SceneObject
description: A single element of a scene: a scanned surface (wall/floor/ceiling/door/window) or detected physical object, modeled after Meta Quest's Scene API / MRUK semantic classifications but kept engine-neutral; or, since 1.1.0, an authored element of a level: a group, a marker, or a prop shown with an asset.

SemanticLabel.description: What the object represents. ROOM ... OTHER are real-world elements of a scan. Since 1.1.0: GROUP (a container with no content of its own), MARKER (a point whose meaning is in metadata.tags, e.g. a spawn point), PROP (an object shown with its asset).

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. the originating spatial anchor UUID.

parentId.description: id of the containing object (e.g. a room), or null for top-level objects.

boundary.description: Set for planar surfaces (floor, ceiling, walls, doors, windows).

volume.description: Set for volumetric objects (furniture) instead of, or in addition to, boundary.

asset.description: Since 1.1.0. Id of the asset (3d-asset-schema) the object is shown with: a model, a light, a sound. Resolved by the engine, e.g. 3d-unity-assets.

metadata.description: metadata.tags carry the roles a game reads, e.g. ["spawn", "team:a"] on a MARKER.
